messages:
Sam (Support): FYI escalating a P1 -> CS. Customer Nimbus AI trial stuck on activation, provisioning 502s for embed service, reported drop in usage and asked for refund. renewal risk if not fixed by EOD.
Ava (CS): Ack. Thanks for flagging. Quick summary of impact + last successful activity? :eyes:
Sam (Support): Impact: trial seats not activated, webhook for ingestion gets 502s, causing their pipeline to back off. Last successful activity 2024-11-15 14:12 UTC. Recent logs: `embed.init -> 502 gateway` repeated ~1800x in last 3 hrs. Link to support ticket: https://redwood.support/t/NT-9123
Sam (Support): Steps we've tried: restarted worker pool, cleared prefix cache, swapped region to eu-west -> still 502. No recent deploys on their account.
Ava (CS): Ok. Sounds like a provisioning/route-level issue rather than model quality. Diego, can we treat this as priority handback? Need comms plan and owner.
Diego (CS Lead): Yep. Assigning CS owner: Ava. Support will keep triage owner: Sam. Ops/SE to take immediate look — Kai? We'll run heartbeat checks, route traces, and a short customer-facing note template.
Kai (Solutions Eng): On it. I'll start a fast trace and check edge LB config + token routing. Quick test command I ran: ```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $REX_KEY" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embed?customer=nimbus"```
Sam (Support): I can share sanitized logs and a dump of request headers. Pasting recent snippet: `X-Region: us-east-1, X-Request-Id: req_6b2c, upstream_status: 502`
oncall-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2024-591 (severity P1). Pager duty alerted.
Ava (CS): Comms plan (draft): 1) Immediate ack to customer within 30m (Sam) 2) Internal triage update every 60m in this thread (Support -> CS) 3) Customer-facing exec note if not resolved in 3h (Diego) 4) Postmortem & follow-up remediation plan incl. credits if downtime >2h (Ava) — assign owners in thread.
Sam (Support): Sent ack at 15:18 UTC. Customer reply: "appreciate the quick response, but trials must work for next demo on Friday" — they're on a short evaluation window.
Diego (CS Lead): Added timeline to calendar: triage check-ins at +1h and +2h. Ava, loop AM to prepare renewal guardrails if we can't meet SLA. Also flag finance for potential credit. cc @finance-team
Kai (Solutions Eng): Found an edge case: our route fallback to the stub model times out when upstream responds with 502 repeatedly, leading to cascade. Quick mitigation: extend fallback timeout to 8s and enable aggressive retry for that customer id. I can push change to staging now and to prod after quick smoke. Will note rollback plan.
Ava (CS): Good action. Prepare short customer note I can send once we have ETA: include apology, what we're doing, ETA to next update, and who to contact. Keep it plain English.
Sam (Support): Rolling the staging patch for fallback timeout. ETA for smoke: 18 mins. Will post results.
Diego (CS Lead): If staging smoke passes, we do canary to 5% of customer traffic for Nimbus, monitor token success and latency. If green, promote. Keep me posted.
Ava (CS): I'll draft the customer message now and queue it for send after the first green canary. Draft: "Hi Team Nimbus — we’ve identified a routing issue causing your activation errors. Our engineers are working on a targeted fix and we expect initial improvements within ~30min. We’ll update again at XX:XX UTC. Contact me directly at ava@redwood.ai for any urgent items." Feedback?
Sam (Support): Looks good, small tweak: add contact for technical updates: kai@redwood.ai.
Ava (CS): Done. Sending once we confirm canary success.
Kai (Solutions Eng): Staging smoke successful. Canary to 5% started at 15:53 UTC. Monitoring upstream_status and embed success rate.
Sam (Support): Canary looks healthy so far, errors down 95% in sampled traffic.
Diego (CS Lead): Proceed to 50% for 10m, then full if stable.
Kai (Solutions Eng): Promoted to 50% -> stable for 12m, promoting to full rollout now. Will monitor for 30m.
oncall-bot: INC-2024-591 status changed to "degraded" -> "mitigated" (automation).
Ava (CS): Sending customer update now with ETA to cleanup and postmortem. Also scheduling a quick enablement session next week to walk their engineers through best practices for provisioning.
Sam (Support): Customer responded: "Thanks — 50% better, we'll re-run demo checklist. Please confirm when fully resolved."
Diego (CS Lead): Marking actions: Kai (SE) - postmortem + root cause analysis, Sam (Support) - collect full request logs, Ava (CS) - send renewal guardrail note + schedule enablement, Diego - coordinate credits if downtime >2h.
Ava (CS): Agree. I'll update renewal risk tracker and close this handback once postmortem posted. :white_check_mark:
Sam (Support): Closing immediate handback: will update every hour until postmortem.
Kai (Solutions Eng): Postmortem draft incoming in 24h, will include mitigation steps and long-term fix timeline.
Ava (CS): Thanks team. Good save.
